proposal.reason: Main functional change is in GIN backends (GDAKI and PROXY) to set/rotate LAG TX port affinity per peer/context, including capability-gated fallback behavior and PROXY queue-depth compatibility handling. Additional network review is needed because shared MLX5 DV symbol/wrapper paths were extended (query/modify QP LAG port and LAG-port discovery with error-policy handling), which is transport-level networking infrastructure beyond a single GIN call site.
